label: TP
reason: User input from the query string is extracted, URL-decoded, passed through doSomething where it is stored in a HashMap and retrieved back into bar, then written directly to the HTTP response via response.getWriter().println(bar) without any HTML encoding or sanitization, resulting in a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input extracted from query string and decoded
Parameter stored in HashMap and retrieved back to bar without sanitization
Unsanitized bar value printed to response causing XSS
